FocusSession.title: FocusSession
FocusSession.description: Represents a logged study timer, stopwatch, Pomodoro, or ultra-focus session.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns the focus session.

mode.description: Timer mode used for the study session.

completed.description: Whether the focus session finished without interruption.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

AppRuleConfig.title: AppRuleConfig
AppRuleConfig.description: Represents a user-configured application selection rule and daily time quota.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who owns this app rule.

isAllowed.description: Whether the app is permitted in the Select Application configuration.

dailyLimitMinutes.description: Permitted daily usage quota in minutes.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the rule was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the rule was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

StudyAssessmentRecord.title: StudyAssessmentRecord
StudyAssessmentRecord.description: Represents a nightly 5-minute mandatory study assessment result.

userId.description: Authenticated user UID who completed the assessment.

passed.description: Whether the student scored >= 60% to pass.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the assessment was recorded (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the assessment was updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/focus_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Stores user focus timer, stopwatch, Pomodoro, and ultra-focus sessions.

/app_configs/{configId}.description: Stores per-user selected application permissions and daily limits.

/study_assessments/{assessmentId}.description: Stores nightly 5-minute study assessment scores and pass/fail status.
